title: Do you own your Land?
summary: Team Law sales page claiming a land patent gives perfect title that cannot be taken for debt or taxes, that warranty deeds are mere colour of title, and urging buyers to secure patents.

assertions.quote: Land cannot be taken for debt or taxes, but Real Estate can be.
a "Warranty Deed" is merely a "color of title"

verdicts.note: A warranty deed conveys full legal title from the grantor; the original patent passes with the chain of title automatically.

assertions.quote: there has never been an appellate case where a properly set Land Patent has ever lost its title to the Land

verdicts.note: Appellate courts repeatedly reject land-patent defences to taxes and foreclosure, e.g. Hilgeford v. Peoples Bank.

A land-patent title claim lost on appeal with sanctions; promoters may say this patent was not 'properly secured', but the court holds that title derived from a patent raises no special federal claim.

assertions.quote: any prior owner with lawful right to the land patent could secure it to themselves and evict you off

verdicts.note: Title passes through recorded deeds; a patent cannot be reclaimed by a prior owner to evict a later buyer.
